title: Quickly Crisped Ukrainian Khao Khua Fried Rice
description: A crispy, grassy Ukrainian dish made with tamarind paste and fried rice, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped carrots and cabbage, and cook until slightly tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir in the tamarind paste, salt, black pepper, and keto seasoning blend.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is crispy and golden brown.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for an additional minute.
Serve the khao khua fried rice hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
